tool.name: SplitSegmentsIntoLevelFeatures
tool.summary: Split segment polylines into subsegments based on the level_rules JSON field and populate a z_index integer field with the level value. This is useful for separating above-ground and below-ground segments such as bridges, tunnels, and overpasses for network analysis or 3D visualisation.

usage.bullet_item: The input features must be polylines containing a level_rules text field with JSON-encoded level definitions from Overture Maps.
Each rule specifies a geometry fraction range and an integer level. New features are created for each range with z_index populated.
Features without level rules or with a single full-range rule default to z_index = 0 and are left unchanged.
If an Output Features path is provided, the input data is copied before splitting and the original features are not modified.

param.name: input_features
param.dialogReference: The polyline feature layer or feature class containing a level_rules field to use for splitting.

param.name: output_features
param.dialogReference: Optional output feature class. When provided, the input features are copied here before splitting and the original data is left untouched.
